{{Template redirect|sfnnb}}
{{Lua|Module:Footnotes|Module:Check for unknown parameters}}

The '''shortened footnote template''' {{tl|sfn}} creates a short [[WP:Citing sources#Short citations|author–date citation]] in a [[Wikipedia:Citing sources|footnote]], with a one-directional link to the first matching [[Wikipedia:Citation templates|citation template]] on the same page. It will combine identical footnotes automatically. 

{{Harvard citation documentation|sfn|noref=1}}
